favoriteTeamIds_help: Open the dropdown to load the current NFL team list from the running adapter. Select one or more favorites, then use Save in the admin toolbar. The adapter writes isFavorite on each team's object and on every game where that team plays.
pollIntervalLiveSeconds_help: How often to refresh the scoreboard while NFL games are in progress (15–300 s). When no game is live the adapter polls every 5 minutes automatically.
archiveSeasonsToKeep_help: Keep the last N ESPN season years under nfl-games.archive. Use 0 to keep all seasons (unlimited).
archiveAllGames_help: When games leave the current scoreboard (after linger), store them under archive/all/{seasonYear}.
archiveFavoriteGames_help: Also store full copies under archive/favorites/{seasonYear} when a favorite team played.
currentPostGameLingerHours_help: After a game leaves the live scoreboard slate, keep it under nfl-games.current for this many hours before moving it to the archive (0 = move immediately).
focusPostGameLingerHours_help: How long views.byTeam.{id}.focus stays on the finished result before switching to the next upcoming game.
viewsTodayMaxSlots: Max games in today/live view slots
viewsTodayMaxSlots_help: Maximum number of numbered slots under views.today / views.live / views.favorites.today (1–32). Slots are only created while games exist there — empty placeholders are not kept.
writeViewJson_help: When enabled, writes JSON strings (e.g. views.today.scoreboard) for scripts and custom JS widgets. Flat states are always written.
scheduleEnabled_help: When enabled, builds schedule/{seasonYear}/type{N}/week{M}/{eventId} from ESPN (preseason, regular, postseason). Used for byTeam focus and next-favorite beyond the live scoreboard week.
schedulePollIntervalHours_help: How often to refresh the full multi-week schedule (1–48 h). Independent of the live scoreboard poll.
writeLogoBase64_help: Off by default (recommended). Logos stay as files under the adapter namespace; VIS widgets use ESPN CDN URLs. Enable only if you need base64/icon data in the object tree.
